summary: Work in the compositor and layer code tightened synchronization between the browser and GPU, especially when using Metal via ANGLE: GPU fences and shared events are used so compositing and Core Animation stay in step. Scroll and painting plumbing was optimized too — scroll updates are batched across IPC to reduce overhead, scroll-linked properties are handled more correctly, and HDR video surface handling and mask re-recording on sub-pixel moves were improved — all of which help scrolling, zooming, and video playback feel smoother and more correct.
